what: Pill tab row and card stack — the progress fill inside the chosen tab fills from the left over 7s with no easing, then moves on to the next tab. On the change, the front card shrinks to .976x and fades out, and the new card appears settling from 1.065x vertical scale to full size around its top axis (.5s cubic-bezier(.44,0,.56,1)). Clicking a tab goes to that tab and progress restarts from zero. When the panel is off screen, progress pauses.

options.[data-fx-part=tab]: Tab buttons (in order) — the chosen tab gets is-fx-on and aria-selected=true
options.[data-fx-part=fill]: Progress slot inside the tab (optional) — color set by the consuming css
options.[data-fx-part=deck] > [data-fx-part=card: One card per tab — stacked in the same spot. The pale panel behind goes in another child of deck
options.dur: Card change duration (sec), default .5 — 0 means instant
options.press · stretch: Size of the outgoing card · initial vertical scale of the incoming card, default .976 · 1.065
